name: OpenAI promotes GPT-Live outbound telephony to GA: voice agents dial out over any SIP trunk with HD Voice and DTMF
title: OpenAI promotes GPT-Live outbound telephony to GA: voice agents dial out over any SIP trunk with HD Voice and DTMF
summary: OpenAI realtime lead Justin Uberti said the GPT-Live outbound telephony API is generally available for all organizations. Developers create a Live session with transport.type sip, dial an E.164 number through a TLS SIP trunk (Twilio, Telnyx and similar), and can send and receive DTMF while the call runs. Docs cover inbound webhooks, outbound create-session, sideband attach, refer/hangup, a 3-minut
